title: Branding
description: Logo and accent colour shown on the PDFs your company generates (RMS, interventions, work orders).

logo.label: Company logo
logo.hint: PNG or JPG, max 1 MB. Without a logo the PDFs keep the standard look.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.invalid: Enter a colour like #1D4ED8 (6 hex digits).

errors.type: Only PNG or JPG images are allowed.
errors.size: The logo is too large (maximum 1 MB).

signedNote: Already signed documents keep the look they were issued with; the new branding applies to new documents.
